A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we designed a low power fractional N PLL with a class D oscillator, which is powered by an integrated DC DC converter to achieve the stringent spur requirements for NB IoT applications.
we have achieved the lowest reported fractional and reference spur in a sub mW PLL for a narrow band application.
a 1V single supply fractional PLL is implemented in a 65 nm CMOS process that meets the stringent spur performance requirement of NB IoT with 0.55 mW power consumption and 0.11mm2 area.

the DC DC converter can be designed to not degrade spur performance.
the DC DC powered class D VCO can be used in PLLs with stringent spur requirements.
